component.name: OpenMM2
component.summary: Open source reimplementation of Midtown Madness 2

description.p: OpenMM2 is an open source engine that runs Midtown Madness 2 on modern Linux and Windows systems. It aims to reproduce the original game's behaviour faithfully while adding support for any screen resolution, Vulkan and OpenGL rendering, and online multiplayer with automatic port forwarding (UPnP).
OpenMM2 contains no game content. You need your own copy of the original Midtown Madness 2: point OpenMM2 at the disc, a disc image (ISO/BIN/CUE) or an existing installation the first time it starts.
Fixes a crash when an opponent or police car drove onto a road narrower than its lane offset; such cars now steer as in the original game.
Smooth motion at any frame rate (drawn between the simulation steps), network races that start together once every player has loaded, and other players' and the police's damage shown in multiplayer.

Multiplayer fixes: races after the first in a session no longer send everyone back to the lobby, and other players' cars no longer jitter. Multiplayer cruise gains shared traffic and police, run by the host.
